value.rationale: Exact classification of how three sparse constraints disappear under a large natural family of irreversible algebraic dynamics, distinguishing a full projective Singer-line phenomenon absent in the binary quadratic case. The single intrinsic minimal-trinomial span controls the sharp longest memory for every spatial diameter and is visibly not just the local degree (cubic example m=3 versus primitive quintic m=8). The combination of exact all-time filtration and sharp global threshold addresses a quantitative natural question not settled by transitivity or entropy alone.
